selected_items.text: we made a chip and it is fast

selected_items.author: OpenAI
selected_items.text: Since announcing Jalapeno, our first custom inference chip, we've been testing it and the system around it. The results show a major advance: more intelligence from every watt and faster responses, delivering both higher throughput and lower latency in one architecture.
selected_items.context_summary: Thread continues with deployment timing: begin deploying by year-end, Gen 2 in development, Gen 3 taking shape.
selected_items.selection_reason: Primary hardware news of the window; special-account self-contained post.

selected_items.author: OpenAI
selected_items.text: Introducing ChatGPT Business Premium Seats. The new $100 Premium seat is a game changer for small businesses and startups, giving lean teams better tools, faster workflows, and capabilities once reserved for big companies.
selected_items.selection_reason: Concrete pricing/product move, distinct from the chip story.

selected_items.author: claudeai
selected_items.text: Claude now has one memory across chat and Claude Cowork, and you decide what's in it. Hand Cowork a task and it starts from what Claude already knows from your chats.
selected_items.selection_reason: Anthropic product change with user-visible behaviour shift.

selected_items.author: buccocapital
selected_items.text: According to WSJ, Anthropic will likely tell investors that its potential revenue is above $30 trillion.
selected_items.selection_reason: High-engagement reported financial claim citing WSJ.

selected_items.author: leerob
selected_items.text: We just increased the included usage of Grok models in Cursor. Demand has been increasing with the launch of Grok 4.6. We already doubled limits last month with more compute. And now we're raising limits again permanently.
selected_items.selection_reason: Concrete tooling change from a Cursor lead.

selected_items.author: perplexity_ai
selected_items.text: Today we're launching Portable Computer on NVIDIA DGX Spark. Portable Computer is a fully local version of Perplexity Computer, where the entire runtime: orchestrator LLM, subagent LLM, agent harness all run on your local hardware. No cloud dependency.
selected_items.selection_reason: Local-inference product launch on named hardware.

selected_items.author: Figure_robot
selected_items.text: Introducing Index. Today we're coming out of stealth with the largest and most diverse robot dataset to scale general purpose robots. To date we've crossed 264,000 app downloads and uploaded 16 million videos.
selected_items.selection_reason: Concrete robotics dataset release with numbers.

selected_items.author: AndrewYNg
selected_items.text: OpenWorker, an open source agent that doesn't just chat but completes tasks on your laptop, just released a new version with many features for security workflows. After our initial release, many users found it especially useful for cybersecurity.
selected_items.selection_reason: Open-source agent release with a specific use case shift.

selected_items.author: arena
selected_items.text: Big news: Qwen3.8-27B by Alibaba_Qwen is now #1 among open models in the Image-to-WebDev Arena (#7 overall). Priced at $0.40/$3 per M input/output tokens. Qwen3.8-27B has 1574 pts with 27B parameters.
selected_items.selection_reason: Concrete benchmark result with pricing, distinct from prior Qwen coverage angles.

selected_items.author: openbb_finance
selected_items.text: Today, we're sharing a difficult update. OpenBB is winding down as a company. At the same time, we are committing to release the OpenBB product suite under a permissive open-source license. That includes OpenBB Workspace, OpenBB Copilot, OpenBB Excel Add-in.
selected_items.selection_reason: Company shutdown plus open-sourcing of an AI finance product suite.

selected_items.author: styskin
selected_items.text: Today we are announcing KeenableAI, an AI-native index of the best human knowledge we have, starting with the open web. AI seems to know just about everything until you ask it about something you know deeply.
selected_items.selection_reason: New company launch addressing retrieval depth.

selected_items.author: MaxForAI
selected_items.text: Shopify CEO Tobi Lutke publicly pressures Anthropic: if Claude Code continues to refuse reading AGENTS.md and .agents/skills, he's considering disabling Claude Code directly within Shopify.
selected_items.selection_reason: Named enterprise dispute over agent config standards.

selected_items.author: GergelyOrosz
selected_items.text: I see so many people asking: why is Ramp building their own coding agent? Spotify an agentic development environment? Thomson Reuters their own AI model? It's because AI made building cheaper, and more profitable.
selected_items.selection_reason: Practitioner analysis of build-versus-buy shift with named companies.
